# ARDA Astro Template

> A modern, feature-rich website template built by the Advanced Research & Development Agency (ARDA) using Astro 5 and TailwindCSS 4. Perfect for SAAS platforms, startups, marketing websites, landing pages, and blogs. ARDA is dedicated to bringing high-tech products to the average person through innovative web solutions.

## Technical Features

### Astro 5.x Integration
- Component islands architecture for optimal performance
- File-based routing with dynamic slug pages
- Content collections with Zod schema validation
- MDX support for enhanced markdown content
- TypeScript support throughout the codebase

### TailwindCSS 4.x Implementation
- Utility-first CSS framework integration
- Custom theme system with 15 CSS custom properties per theme
- Responsive design patterns and mobile optimization
- Typography plugin for enhanced text styling

### Advanced Theme System
- 17 unique color themes ranging from light to dark modes
- Real-time theme switching with localStorage persistence
- Theme-aware components using CSS custom properties
- ColorPaletteSelector component for theme management

### Modal and Component Systems
- Reusable modal components with backdrop and content slots
- Data-attribute system for modal control (data-modal-open/close)
- Theme-integrated popup system with accessibility features
- Comprehensive UI component library (buttons, links, cards)

### SEO and Performance
- Built-in SEO optimization with astro-seo integration
- Automatic sitemap generation
- Optimized image handling with multiple format support
- Lighthouse-ready performance optimization

## Development Resources

### Documentation
- [CLAUDE.md](/CLAUDE.md) - AI development instructions and guidelines
- [README.md](https://github.com/areimel/arda-astro-template/blob/main/README.md) - Setup and development guide
- Component documentation within styleguide pages

### Code Structure
- Organized component architecture with ui/ and specialized directories
- Centralized data management via JSON files in src/data/
- Content collections for scalable content management
- Path aliases (@/* and ~/*) for clean imports

## Getting Started

This template provides everything needed to build modern web applications:

1. **Clone and Install**: Use as GitHub template or clone repository
2. **Development**: Run `pnpm dev` for local development server
3. **Customization**: Modify content collections, themes, and components
4. **Deployment**: Build with `pnpm build` and deploy to any static hosting platform

The template is designed for developers, agencies, and businesses looking for a comprehensive starting point with modern web technologies, extensive customization options, and professional design patterns.

## About ARDA

The Advanced Research & Development Agency (ARDA) specializes in creating innovative web solutions that combine cutting-edge technology with user-friendly design. Our mission is making high-tech products accessible to everyone through thoughtful development and design practices.
